info.title: Revision tip
info.text: Write the three file size formulas on a card and test yourself until you can write them from memory.

info.title: Common slip
info.text: Forgetting to divide by 8 turns bits into bytes wrongly, and costs a mark in nearly every series.

info.title: Definitions win marks
info.text: Sampling, metadata, character set, lossy and lossless are all 1 or 2-mark definition questions.

info.title: Compression choice
info.text: If the question involves text, a program or a spreadsheet, the answer is always lossless.

info.title: Quality and size
info.text: Almost every question here can be answered with: more bits means better quality and a bigger file.

info.title: Binary blitz
info.text: Use the Binary blitz challenge to get fast at conversions: they appear in nearly every paper.
